attributes.name: Iesha Foxglove
attributes.powers:
Iesha is immune to the Mental and Poison traits.

If your check to defeat Iesha does not have the Magic trait, Iesha is undefeated.

If defeated, choose a location deck and search it for the villain The Skinsaw Man. If you find him, set him aside; shuffle the rest of the deck and put him on either the top or bottom of the deck. If you encounter the Skinsaw Man this turn, the difficulty of all checks against him is decreased by 5.
